why: The vantage's approach trigger given a lever: a prop is the visible object a click acts on at its own cell, and an approach is a body's position - the lever would be placed and nothing would ever read it. Refused rather than ignored, because a field that binds to nothing is the shape every other probe here exists to catch. It declares no unit: `prop` on a trigger is bound by the ferry's tiller (a `use`, whose flip vanilla reports) and by the hearth's stone (a `strike`, whose hit area is fitted over the stone).
